newsitem.title: USA: TCI to create two new series of stock.
newsitem.headline: TCI to create two new series of stock.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Thursday that it has filed preliminary proxy materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to the creation of two new series of common stock, to be designated as the Series A Telephony Group Common Stock and the Series B Telephony Group Common Stock.
The company said that these equity securities would be intended to reflect the separate performance of the newly created Telephony Group.
The Telephony Group will not include TCI's residential telephone business and the WTCI microwave company.

The timing, size and pricing of the offering will be determined by the board of directors, based on then current market conditions and other factors following shareholder approval of the target stock, the company said.
